description_en: Queries the information of default algorithms
kebab_example: aliyun airec describe-default-algorithms --instance-id airec-cn-xxxxxx --scene-id test --api-version 2020-11-26 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDefaultAlgorithms

items.description_en: The information about the array object

category.description_en: The algorithm category. Valid values: RECALL and RANK
category.description_zh:
算法类目
RECALL  召回
RANK  排序

config.description_en: The information about the child configuration item

items.description_en: The information about the array object

defaultValue.description_en: The default value of the algorithm configuration item

experimentValue.description_en: The custom value of the algorithm configuration item

key.description_en: The key of the algorithm configuration item

name.description_en: The name of the algorithm configuration item. (Note: If you use the default algorithm, the console obtains the algorithm name from Medusa. If you customize an algorithm for the experiment, the algorithm name is directly returned.)
name.description_zh:
算法配置项name
（说明：系统默认算法，控制台需要通过美杜莎获取，用户自定义算法，后端会返回name）

defaultValue.description_en: The default value of the algorithm. If you set key to i2i, hot, or new, the value of this parameter is true or false. If you set key to mtorder, the value of this parameter is a list of filtering algorithms ranked by priority
defaultValue.description_zh:
算法默认值
对于i2i,hot,new等召回算法为"true"/"false"
对于mtorder为各路召回链路的排序

experimentValue.description_en: The custom value of the algorithm

hasConfig.description_en: Indicates whether child configuration items exist. Valid values: true and false
hasConfig.description_zh:
是否有子配置项
true  是
false  否

key.description_en: The algorithm key. Valid values: i2i: the I2I filtering algorithm. u2x2i: the U2X2I filtering algorithm. hot: the filtering algorithm for popular items. new: the filtering algorithm for new items. embedding: the vector filtering algorithm. mtorder: the priority of the filtering algorithm. rankservice: the ranking service
key.description_zh:
算法key
I2I   I2I召回链路
u2X2I    U2X2I召回链路
hot  热门商品召回链路
new    新品召回链路
embedding    向量召回链路
mtorder    召回链路优先级
rankservice    排序服务

name.description_en: The algorithm name. (Note: If you use the default algorithm, the console obtains the algorithm name from Medusa. If you customize an algorithm for the experiment, the algorithm name is directly returned.)
name.description_zh: 名称（说明：系统默认算法，控制台需要通过美杜莎获取，用户自定义算法，后端会返回name）

type.description_en: The algorithm type. Valid values: SYSTEM and CUSTOM
type.description_zh:
算法类别
SYSTEM 系统默认类型
CUSTOM 用户自定义类型
